excerpt_i18n.en: On May 20, the 2026 "ByteDance Scholarship" officially opened for applications. The scholarship targets university students in cutting-edge technology fields, offering a cash reward of up to 300,000 RMB per awardee and their advisor. This year, the program has expanded its application scope to global universities for the first time, and the number of awardees will exceed last year's 20 recipients. According to reports, the ByteDance Scholarship was launched in 2021, aiming to inspire the most promising young researchers in technology to "explore the frontiers of intelligence" and drive breakthroughs in AI-related research and applications. Candidates are expected to have innovative ideas, practical achievements, or be exploring solutions to long-term valuable problems in fields such as artificial intelligence, computer science and technology, and basic sciences. Even if research is ongoing, candidates can submit applications based on interim results. Over the six years since its inception, ByteDance has continuously increased its investment in the program: the number of awardees has grown from 10 in the first year to over 20; the selection scope has expanded from mainland China to global universities; the individual research incentive for awardees has increased from 100,000 RMB to 200,000 RMB, which can be freely used for research needs. Additionally, the program pioneered a 100,000 RMB advisor bonus in the industry to recognize advisors' contributions to talent cultivation. Beyond financial support, the ByteDance Scholarship also focuses on broadening the academic horizons of young scholars. Awardees will be invited to join the ByteScholars research community, engaging in regular exchanges with renowned scholars, industry experts, and past recipients. Many previous awardees have noted that the scholarship has significantly expanded their academic perspectives.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 20 de mayo se anunció la apertura de solicitudes para la "Beca ByteDance 2026". Esta beca está dirigida a estudiantes universitarios en áreas de tecnología de vanguardia, ofreciendo una recompensa en efectivo de hasta 300,000 yuanes chinos para cada estudiante galardonado y su tutor. Este año, el programa amplía por primera vez el alcance de las solicitudes a universidades de todo el mundo, y el número de becados superará los 20 del año pasado. Según se informa, la Beca ByteDance se inició en 2021, con el objetivo de incentivar a los jóvenes investigadores con mayor potencial en el campo tecnológico, animándolos a "explorar los límites de la inteligencia hacia lo desconocido", para impulsar avances en la investigación y aplicación de la inteligencia artificial. La beca espera que los candidatos tengan logros innovadores en áreas como inteligencia artificial, ciencias de la computación y tecnología, ciencias básicas, entre otras.

On May 19, the internationally authoritative market research firm Omdia released its latest report, "China AI Cloud Market Share 2025." In 2025, the total size of China's AI cloud market reached 56.7 billion RMB. Alibaba Cloud ranked first in both AI IaaS and MaaS, with its overall share rising from 35.8% in the first half of the year to 38.1%, maintaining a solid lead and surpassing the combined total of the second to fourth place providers.  

Caption: Omdia "China AI Cloud Market Share 2025" – Alibaba Cloud ranks first.  

Omdia believes that cloud computing is undergoing its most profound paradigm shift due to the rise of large AI models, necessitating a systematic reassessment of China's AI cloud market. For the first time, Omdia defines AI cloud as two core areas: AI IaaS and MaaS. MaaS is further subdivided into MPS (Model Production Service), focused on model redevelopment, and MCS (Model Consumption Service), primarily based on token consumption.  

According to Omdia's report, China's AI cloud market experienced significant growth in 2025, with a total market size of approximately 56.7 billion RMB. IaaS accounted for about 69%, while MaaS made up around 31%. Overall, Alibaba Cloud held the largest market share at 38.1%, followed by Volcano Engine, Baidu Cloud, Tencent Cloud, and Tianyi Cloud in second to fifth place. The combined market share of the top five cloud providers exceeded 80%.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 19 de mayo, la autoridad internacional de investigación de mercado Omdia publicó el informe "Cuota de mercado de la nube de IA en China 2025". En 2025, el mercado total de la nube de IA en China alcanzó los 56.700 millones de yuanes. Alibaba Cloud ocupó el primer lugar tanto en AI IaaS como en MaaS, con una cuota total que aumentó del 35,8 % en el primer semestre al 38,1 %, manteniéndose en general en el primer puesto, superando la suma del segundo al cuarto lugar. Leyenda: Omdia "Cuota de mercado de la nube de IA en China 2025" Alibaba Cloud en primer lugar. Omdia considera que la computación en la nube ha experimentado el cambio de paradigma más profundo debido al auge de los grandes modelos de IA.
